question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** "could."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb** "could"** is the most appropriate choice to fill in the blank in this sentence.
 
• **"Could"** is the past tense of** "can"** and is used to indicate ability or possibility in the past.
 
 
• **Example**: *I could help you.*
 
 
 
• The other options do not fit grammatically or contextually in the sentence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• Correct passage:

I know these authors to be__ outstanding individuals and remarkable teachers and consultants and have even __seen__ them work their magic in training seminars, but I didn’t know if they __**could**__ take this complex topic and fit into a book. They did. I ______ 4 ______ you to really dig into this material, to pause and think deeply about each part and how the parts are ______ 5 ______.
